content.title: Merger between TowneBank and Old Point National Bank is a done deal
content.summary: The merger between two of Hampton Roads’ major community banks is now complete. Suffolk-based TowneBank and Hampton-based Old Point National Bank concluded the $203 million deal on Sept. 1. Old Point Financial Corp., the parent company of The Old Point National Bank of Phoebus and Old Point Trust & Financial Services, is now part of TowneBank.
